description: Search Japanese authority (FSA, BOJ, MOF) updates by publication date range and authority. Price: $0.05 per call (x402, USDC).

from.description: YYYY-MM-DD (00:00:00Z) or ISO-8601 timestamp. Returns items with published_at >= from.

to.description: YYYY-MM-DD (23:59:59Z) or ISO-8601 timestamp; default now. At most 92 days after from.

name: jp_authorities_search
